wordProblems.q: Lily bakes 13 cookies. She eats 3 of them. How many cookies are left?
There are 9 birds on a tree. 6 birds fly away. How many birds are left on the tree?
Owen has 9 pencils. Owen finds 6 more pencils in a drawer. How many pencils does Owen have now?
Sam has 12 balloons. 6 balloons pop. How many balloons does Sam have left?
Layla has 13 books on her shelf. Her mum buys her 2 more books. How many books does Layla have now?
Ben has 14 crayons. He loses 4 crayons at school. How many crayons does Ben have left?
Isabella picks 4 oranges from a tree. Then Isabella picks 2 more oranges. How many oranges did Isabella pick in all?
There are 9 ducks in a pond. 2 ducks swim away. How many ducks are left in the pond?
Ava makes 5 cupcakes. Her friend brings 8 more cupcakes. How many cupcakes are there in all?
Ben has 8 toy cars. He gives 3 toy cars to his little brother. How many toy cars does Ben have left?
Emma finds 9 seashells on the beach in the morning and 3 seashells in the afternoon. How many seashells did Emma find in all?
Sophia has 14 flowers in her garden. She picks 3 flowers for her teacher. How many flowers are left in the garden?
Max eats 10 grapes at lunch and 2 grapes after school. How many grapes did Max eat in all?
Emma is reading a book with 14 pages. Emma reads 8 pages today. How many pages are left to read?
A baker makes 8 muffins in the morning and 6 muffins in the afternoon. How many muffins did the baker make in all?
There are 8 fish in a tank. The shop sells 3 fish. How many fish are left in the tank?
Layla has 12 red beads and 2 blue beads. How many beads does Layla have in all?
Max collects 15 toy trains. He lends 11 trains to a friend. How many trains does Max have left?
Mia has 12 apples in a basket. Mia eats 8 apples. How many apples are left in the basket?
Lily draws 2 stars on Monday and 2 stars on Tuesday. How many stars did Lily draw in all?
There are 7 rabbits in a garden. 1 rabbit hops away. How many rabbits are left in the garden?
Henry builds a tower with 7 blocks. Then he adds 8 more blocks on top. How many blocks are in the tower now?
Nora has 8 buttons in a box. She uses 7 buttons to sew a dress. How many buttons are left in the box?
Nora buys 13 peaches at the market. Then Nora buys 2 more peaches. How many peaches did Nora buy in all?
There are 9 frogs sitting on a log. 1 frog jumps into the water. How many frogs are left on the log?
Ava collects 11 smooth rocks at the river and 3 smooth rocks at the lake. How many smooth rocks did Ava collect in all?
Isabella has 14 cherries in a bowl. She gives 3 cherries to her friend. How many cherries are left in the bowl?
8 red buses and 7 yellow buses are parked at the station. How many buses are parked at the station in all?
Sophia has 9 pairs of socks in a drawer. Sophia takes 3 pairs out to wear this week. How many pairs of socks are left in the drawer?
Omar flies 11 kites in the park. His dad brings 2 more kites. How many kites are there now?
